name: cp_duckboat
subject: a cute two-seat pedal boat shaped like a white duck, exact side view, the duck head at the left end facing left: a big round white duck head with a friendly black eye with a white glint and an orange beak on a tall curved neck at the front; a long low white hull with a flat top deck, a red stripe along the hull, a small blue seat back in the middle, a short upturned duck tail at the right end
part_map: the long light grey shape at the bottom is the hull (its flat top is the deck the dog stands on), the darker band its stripe, the tall light shape at the left the neck and round head, the orange point the beak, the small dark grey block the seat back, the small point at the right the tail.
size_sentence: the boat is nearly twice as long as the dog and the duck's head is a little higher than the dog's head when she stands on the deck.

slot.where: City Park tall, the pond (x 816-944): the DUCK BOAT mover (Tiled movers), deck = the mover's top y 346, drawn by scene.lua Sc.drawMoverArt
